Judgments below rest on the page 41, 58 and 60 quotes. Items 4, 5, 9, 13, 15, 22 and 23 omit the unit, which is acceptable, but the other items need care on unit and setting.

**Mammogram (items 0, 1, 13, 20).** Page 41 shows "$0 copay for each diagnostic mammogram." The layout is a bit interleaved, but the text is clear. The units "per diagnostic mammogram" (0) and "per mammogram" (20) are fine, and item 13 has no unit. "Per visit" (item 1) is a different unit from "each diagnostic mammogram", so it is false.

**Page 58, outpatient diagnostic tests (setting any).**
- Items 2 and 10 (CT, "per CT scan" and "per scan") are true.
- Item 4 (CT, no unit) is true.
- Item 19 (CT, "per visit") is false because the unit does not match.
- Item 3 (diagnostic, "per visit") is false.
- Item 5 (diagnostic, $350, quoting both the non-CT diagnostic row and the CT row) is true. The diagnostic benefit covers other-than-CT services at $350 and CT at $350, so the combined amount is $350.
- Items 24 and 25 (diagnostic, "per diagnostic radiology service" and "per service") are true.
- Items 9 and 16 (x-ray, no unit and "per x-ray") are true.
- Item 18 (x-ray, "per visit") is false.

**Page 60, outpatient hospital.**
- Items 6 and 22 (x-ray, "per x-ray" and no unit) are true.
- Item 11 (x-ray, "per visit") is false.
- Items 7, 12 and 15 (CT, "per CT scan", "per scan" and no unit) are true.
- Item 14 (CT, "per visit") is false.
- Items 8, 21 and 23 (diagnostic, "per diagnostic radiology service", "per service" and no unit) are true.
- Item 17 (diagnostic, "per visit") is false.
